tools.name: tlp_quote
tools.description: Get a USD estimate and a link to continue on The Letter Pilot for one domestic First-Class, Certified, or Priority Mail letter. Supports 1–20 US Letter pages printed black-and-white and single-sided. Provide only the service and page count.

tools.name: tlp_prepare_mailing
tools.description: Get an expiring link the customer opens on The Letter Pilot. With their approval after sign-in, the site saves an unpaid Quick Send draft. Enter documents, addresses, and payment details only on the site. Provide only the service and page count.

tools.name: tlp_prepare_letter
tools.description: Prepare one domestic US Letter mailing with the customer's approved recipient, return address and finished letter. Provide exact finished text or a customer-selected PDF attachment and a unique UUID request_id. Reuse the request ID only to retry the same mailing. The customer opens the private link

tools.name: tlp_mailing_status
tools.description: Return the payment and mailing status and available USPS tracking for a letter prepared by this integration. Use only the private status_reference returned for this customer’s mailing. A paid or printing status does not mean the letter has been mailed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "tlp_prepare_letter" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
